messages:
Jordan: Kicking off change window canary for embed-service v2026.3 -> rolling 10% traffic now.
deploy-bot: [deploy-started] deploy_id=dep_2026_3 canary_percent=10 region=us-west-2
Priya: copying SLO dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/embed-service/slo (watch p95/p99 + error rate)
Linh: quick heads-up — small 502 burst on eu region just after traffic shift, 3 total in 5m
Samir: seeing a p95 jump on embeddings endpoint, baseline ~180ms -> 430ms; p99 also elevated
Priya: oncall-bot pinged for SLO breach? @oncall-bot do we have auto-alerts configured for this window
oncall-bot: ALERT: embed-service error_rate p99 > 0.5% threshold (window=5m). Incident created: INC-613
Jordan: pausing rollout at 10% and holding. steps: pause traffic, gather logs, quick rollback decision
Samir: rerouted canary traffic off eu-1 -> fallback routing to us-west-2 to isolate region issue
Priya: can we confirm model variant? v2026.3 uses quantized q4_KVcache_opt; previous was v2026.2 float16
Linh: logs from canary-workers:
```
worker-7 ERROR OOM while allocating KV cache (seq_len=4096)
worker-8 WARN slow_kv_cache_miss count=12
```
Samir: that OOM matches the p95 spike. Suggest pinning to v2026.2 for the canary routes until we diagnose.
Jordan: what's the tolerance here? errorbudget still has ~0.3% left for the window but trending fast
Priya: recommend rollback to v2026.2 for all canary routes and then re-run smoke tests. @Jordan can you authorize?
Jordan: +1 authorize rollback. Initiating rollback per runbook step 3.
deploy-bot: [rollback-started] deploy_id=dep_2026_3 rollback_to=dep_2026_2 triggered_by=Jordan
oncall-bot: NOTE: post-rollback monitor configured for 15m sampling, will alert on >0.2% error rate
Linh: running quick smoke: `curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://embed.internal/api/v1/encode | jq .latency`
Linh: smoke results: latency 190ms, no 5xx in last 1m
Priya: checking SLO dashboard — p95 back to 185ms, error_rate down to 0.08% (15m)
Samir: I'll open a short postmortem and add a bullet to release notes about quantization regression and add a guard to preflight checks
Jordan: update release changelog and notify product: "rolled back v2026.3 canary due to KV cache OOM under extended seq_len workloads"
Priya: adding follow-ups: (1) add KV cache sizing check to preflight smoke, (2) run larger seq_len load test in staging w/ q4 profile, (3) consider fallback to smaller seq_len by default
Samir: filing ticket ENG-4281 for the preflight and ENG-4282 for quantization traceability
Jordan: closing this thread; monitor shows baseline stable for 20m. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: [deploy-closed] deploy_id=dep_2026_3 status=rolled_back
oncall-bot: INCIDENT INC-613 resolved (root cause: KV cache OOM on quantized variant).
